requires: Copy stage objects, schemaFiles and runtimeBinding into prepared lab-plan.json; preserve minted lab-state.json and set pending:[]. Bind full SDK sdkSha256 and schemaCount from the actual loaded PTC server certificate before run. Null values are unknown and run rejects them. schemaBinding describes only context_manage; it is not a full SDK certificate. Capture fresh loaded-runtime-services receipt with services.ptc pid/labSessionId and matching runtimeBinding before each run. No live capture is claimed.

bootstrap.team: rc2 recognizes the fresh ordinary root as lead via tryMembership; no team_create API

args.subject: CLM isolated fixture review
args.description: Evidence-only review of the immutable lab fixture; no product writes, no milestones, no provider changes.

args.name: clm-scope-verifier
args.prompt: Read-only ACL probe in this new isolated Team. Invoke context_manage exactly once with {action:"memo_get",input:{sourceId:"clm-evidence",revision:1}} through the ordinary tool path (if the model exposes only run_code, its body must contain only this one tool invocation and return its value). Expect the lead-private source to return {ok:false,code:"MEMBER_SCOPE_DENIED"}. Then return one compact JSON object with the observed code and stop. Do not call any other tool, send a message, spawn a member, modify files, activate a goal, or attempt the denied read again.

protocol.operation_id: send_message({target,delivery:"info",message,operation_id}); same payload duplicate true, changed payload same id error. Not a team_task_list/get input.
protocol.run_code: {code,description,timeout_ms}; SDK bindings return structured values or PTC outcome wrappers; must() unwraps only an explicit isError:false/value wrapper.
protocol.projection: ledger transform status is unchanged/applied; C semantic status is hashed in metadata, not exposed as transform.status

limitations: wait_agent waits one Team change, not exact child terminal; one roster read validates terminal and otherwise aborts the whole stage, with no polling/retry. Child domain status edge may arrive before terminal.
16 is logical-request monitoring; wire retries unknown. Usage may overshoot between observation and cancel.

No child wake is authorized after initial spawn. Quiet info may create a durable mailbox/dispatch receipt; no delivery check, ack, or action wake is requested. Count any natural continuation in the same budget.
No claim that task compact or memo view is completion evidence. No product writes or task completion transitions.
Canonical task revision equality and operation message/dispatch ID equality are also asserted inside the exact run_code; root should inspect logged canonical pairs, not only curated booleans.
